name: Basilica of Saints Cyril and Methodius
history: The Sisters of Saints Cyril and Methodius built this chapel at their motherhouse, Villa Sacred Heart, during the Great Depression. It was dedicated on 17 October 1939, and Pope John Paul II raised it to a minor basilica on 30 June 1989.
arch: A Romanesque Revival convent chapel. Inside are travertine marble walls, a tiled vaulted ceiling, terrazzo floors and oak pews.
features: The marble altar stands under a carved marble baldachin.
Life-size mosaics show Saints Cyril and Methodius, the apostles to the Slavs.

look.d: The chapel's tower rises over the sisters' motherhouse.
Behind these doors are life-size mosaics of Saints Cyril and Methodius.

fun: It is a convent chapel first, and also a basilica.
journal: Built in hard times by sisters who taught generations. Marble, mosaic, and patience.
